text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Three... okay. Mission tile... “Until you land on the next mission tile, your sentence endings must all be ‘Gepyo-i’” ... r-really~~ gepyo-i...

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, what language is ‘Gepyo-i’!? A cry? Also this course is like 10m per tile. Huge!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Alright, next is me! A six! ...Ah, I might go off the board soon!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. You two are making quite fast progress. Now then, many more fun things await ahead...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Beyond here there will be many more mission-type tiles. Special missions may also appear.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And after you pass the central plaza, the final goal, the gymnasium, awaits. Do your best.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Wahhh it’s really a giant sugoroku even outside!! Amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Five, six... okay! Hmm, this is... “The King’s Tile”?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Here, obey the king’s decree. You shall... hmm, sing a hymn praising the king. Original or parody is fine.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Eh!? O-Orfe-sama!? A song... is it!? ...A-alright... here I go! ...Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Beautiful! Orfe-sama you always shine~♪ You’re full of power and super strong in races~! Umm, uh...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm... not bad, but a little clumsy. Then—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Sister. Show her an example.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Me? Sing?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yes. Since you’ve gone through the trouble of dressing the part. A simple hymn in my honor should be easy.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: A-amazing... he’s forcing even his big sister... what’s going to happen...!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Very well... with humility.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahh my proud beloved sister♪ Supreme king overflowing with brilliance♪ Ahh those eyes see through all things♪ And that wise noble visage grows ever more dignified♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahh my proud beloved sister♪ Reigning over the world with majestic grace♪ Yet with a pure heart shining bright, drawing everyone strongly day by day♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Was that satisfactory? It was sudden, so I fear my feelings may have spilled out too strongly...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ah. Praise from you is truly pleasant. Sing again.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: A-amazing... the mental fortitude for such a long piece... or rather the lyrics were too perfect!? I-I can’t compete...

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah! Right, my next tile... oh, “The King’s Tile” again...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Oh? Quite the luck. Then you shall—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Offer a delicious sweet. Handmade is fine.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: From now!? That’s insane pressure... or maybe a reward?? A-alright, I’ll go borrow the kitchen!!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume E
text_block_list.text: Whoa—! Almost at the goal! I’ll dash straight through!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume E
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah! Let’s see... move four tiles... “Perform a gag. If it bombs, skip one turn”! That’s insane...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: As a challenger, you must obey orders. Now, show me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san, wait! Even if it’s a game, this is too much—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Oh? Then you perform in her stead. Go on.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wha—!? Ugh, this too is for Christmas peace...! Leave it to me! “The futon flew away”!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You skip a turn.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Good, good. Truly amusing dancing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Therefore... I must grant a reward. ...Now, it is time to overturn heaven and earth.

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Waaa!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Rejoice. The direction of progression shall now reverse. Retrace the path you walked.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume Group
text_block_list.text: Ehhh!? We were so close!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? This is... haha, look players. It’s a dreamland full of reward tiles.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall bestow rewards according to the tile upon which you land. Now, seize them.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume Group
text_block_list.text: Amazing amazing! There are even Orfe-sama’s favorite tea leaves! Wow! A tile to get every mahjong tile signed by Nakayama-san...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nobody told me that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There’s also the clay reindeer I made♡ Fight for it with everything you’ve got☆

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Oh... you drew the “One-day Vassal Ticket.”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You shall be my loyal vassal— for one day, serve as my close attendant.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Of course, my radiance shining upon you is not limited to one day. I shall allow you to serve eternally as well. ...Work hard.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Your reward is “goldwork,” is it? Good draw. I shall choose one for you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm... with your looks... a delicate ornament shall suit you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Take this. The honor of adorning your neck. When meeting me, you must wear it.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume F
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I got the parallel-run ticket with Orfe-senpai...! Amazing! I’ll stomp through every present tile on the way!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume F
text_block_list.text: Oh, next tile is— “Aim for the top of manzai with Gold Ship”! Me...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Good, good. Bring back plenty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is also the king’s duty to reward the people. Tonight, I shall show you the supreme dream...
